answer_1.quote: We report test accuracy using the model with the best validation GLEU score... We build a simple yet effective baseline model based on BART trained from our datasets.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our model using M2 scorer and GLEU (Section 2)... We also report self-scores (self-GLEU and self-M2).

answer_4.quote: We evaluate our system by 3 Korean GEC experts majoring in Korean linguistics... Each evaluator evaluated "good" or "bad" for each parallel sentences.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators marked each automatically classified edit as "good" (correct) or "bad" (incorrect).
